title: ScrumFlow Platform
description: Health of the whole ScrumFlow stack on the EC2 instance: API, AI service, gateway, PostgreSQL, host and containers.

panels.title: Service status
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape each component (backend, AI service, gateway, database, host, containers).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="scrumflow-backend", uri!~"/up|/actuator.*", uri=~"$uri", status=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="scrumflow-backend", uri!~"/up|/actuator.*", uri=~"$uri"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: AI analyses running
panels.description: Gemini calls in progress right now.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Rules from monitoring/prometheus/alerts.yml that are currently firing.

targets.expr: sort_desc(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application="scrumflow-backend", uri!~"/up|/actuator.*", uri=~"$uri"}[1h]))) > 0)
sort_desc(sum by (method, uri, status) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="scrumflow-backend", uri!~"/up|/actuator.*", uri=~"$uri", status=~"[45].."}[1h])) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No errors in the last hour

panels.title: Sign-in activity
panels.description: Logins, sign-ups, Google sign-in, token refreshes and password resets. Many 401s on /api/login suggest password guessing.

panels.title: Application log events
panels.description: Errors and warnings written to the backend log (per second).

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Seconds spent in GC per second, and pauses per second.

panels.title: Database connection pool (HikariCP)
panels.description: 'waiting' above 0 means requests are queued for a connection.

panels.title: Backend uptime
panels.description: Time since the backend last started (resets on each deploy).

panels.title: Analyses per minute by endpoint and result
Analysis duration (p50 / p95) by endpoint
panels.description: Mostly the time Gemini takes to answer.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of reads served from memory; below 99% the database is reading from disk.

panels.title: Container uptime
panels.description: A short uptime outside a deploy means the container restarted.
